children: We started Fade Room because getting a good cut shouldn’t mean guessing at a wait time and hoping for the best. So we built the shop around the booking — pick your barber, pick your slot, done.
Bright room, sharp tools, barbers who actually care about the fade. No frills, no waiting bench, no surprise prices. Just a clean cut on your schedule.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every cut is booked to a real slot and we hold the line to it, so your time means your time.
You book a person, not a queue. Your barber learns your cut and delivers it the same way every visit.
One flat rate per service, shown before you book. What you see on the menu is what you pay in the chair.
